title: THE FREE PLATFORM
voice: Why is your trading platform free? … The charts — free. The account — free. Nobody gives you tools for nothing. So… what's the product?

Here's the mechanism. Many retail brokers never send your order to any market. They take the other side themselves. Your loss is booked — as their revenue. It has a name: the B-book. And it's documented.
Now watch closely. The same company that hosts your trades… earns when you lose. Same screen. Same login. Two sides of one book.
You don't have to trust me. European rules force them to print it on their own websites: seven to eight out of ten client accounts lose money. They know the math. The math IS the business.

So the platform was never free. You're not a customer — you are the counterparty. Every order you place needs someone on the other side. Here… that someone is the house. When you lose, it slides to them.
Know whose book your order lands in. Ask your broker one question — A-book, or B? … The silence is an answer.
